What's new in your portal

🕒
You can now dispute a Late mark

Think a Late is wrong? In Attendance → Recent logs, tap dispute next to the Late badge — or dispute the demerit in HR & Scorecard → My demerits. Add your explanation and proof; your admin reviews it.

📊
Your Career Graph is on your hero card

Under your name: your final score for each month, in color — purple 95+, green 90–94, yellow 80–89, red ≤79.

Why it matters: one purple month — or three green months in a row — earns you a salary increase or career-level promotion. The graph tracks your progress automatically.

⏱️
Time tracking is now refresh-proof

Your running timer and today's bars survive refreshes and slow connections — nothing disappears, and pressing Start can't create a double entry anymore. If your timer was still running, the portal resumes it for you.

📨
New EOD flow

Before sending, you get a private recap of your total hours per task — only you can see it. The EOD channel now shows just "EOD sent to Productivity"; your details go straight to the Productivity Hub. Update your project tool first — the portal will remind you if outputs are missing.

Appeal untracked work

Tell your admin about work that wasn't tracked. It goes for approval and only counts once approved.

You can appeal for today or the past 2 days (48 hours).
